decision_questions.description: 3-6 go/no-go questions, ordered by when they can be answered.

threshold.description: The concrete pass threshold, from the documents.

evidence.description: What evidence answers it and when (Month N).

if_no.description: What a NO means: delay, split, downsize or stop, and how.

contradictions.description: At most 12 contradictions, most severe first. Empty if none.

topic.description: Short label, e.g. 'Tenant price vs electricity cost'.

statement_a.description: Brief quote or paraphrase of the first statement.

statement_b.description: Brief quote or paraphrase of the conflicting statement.

suggested_resolution.description: Which value to keep and why, or what must be clarified.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences on the plan's overall internal consistency.
